import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Source file path
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_67/test_0.csv"
    
    # Load source data
    df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)
    
    # Inspect columns:
    # ['user_id', 'time', 'sore.throat.cough', 'runnynose.congestion.sneezing', 'fever', 
    #  'nausea.vomiting.diarrhea', 'sad.depressed', 'open.stressed']
    
    # Transformation plan:
    # Target schema: ['user_id': int, 'sad': float, 'stressed': float]
    # From source:
    #   - user_id: keep as is
    #   - sad: aggregate 'sad.depressed' by user_id (mean)
    #   - stressed: aggregate 'open.stressed' by user_id (mean)
    #
    # Since source has multiple rows per user_id (different times), we group by user_id and take mean of sad.depressed and open.stressed.
    #
    # Finally, rename columns to match target schema and export.
    
    # Group by user_id and aggregate mean of sad.depressed and open.stressed
    df_agg = df_source0.groupby('user_id', as_index=False).agg({
        'sad.depressed': 'mean',
        'open.stressed': 'mean'
    })
    
    # Rename columns to target schema
    df_agg.rename(columns={
        'sad.depressed': 'sad',
        'open.stressed': 'stressed'
    }, inplace=True)
    
    # Ensure user_id is integer type
    df_agg['user_id'] = df_agg['user_id'].astype(int)
    
    # Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
    df_target = df_agg[['user_id', 'sad', 'stressed']]
    
    # Output path
    output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_67/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    
    # Save to CSV without index
    df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
    
if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
